questions.q: Why does the summary say modern comforts leave so many people unhappy?
a: Ancient survival rewards are exploited by business
People have lost the ability to feel pleasure
Technology has removed all sources of stress
Modern diets contain too few calories
questions.why: Lesson 1 explains that our brains still reward energy-rich food and social approval, and companies profit by targeting those impulses.

questions.q: How does the summary describe social media's effect on the brain?
a: It works like fast food that weakens real connection
It builds deep bonds between distant friends
It has no measurable impact on happiness
It strengthens the brain's ability to focus
questions.why: Lesson 1 calls social media fast food for the brain: it keeps us clicking while damaging our capacity for deep relationships.

questions.q: What does the summary say exercise does for the mind?
a: It stimulates the prefrontal cortex and sharpens thinking
It calms the prefrontal cortex to reduce anxiety
It mainly improves physical appearance, not cognition
It only helps children perform well on tests
questions.why: Lesson 2 says 30 minutes of daily exercise stimulates the prefrontal cortex, the area handling planning and problem-solving.

questions.q: What is the first step of the Brain Wash ten-day program?
a: Starting a digital detox and removing time-wasting apps
Beginning a fast to reset the digestive system
Journaling about the previous year's mistakes
Calling a friend to repair a relationship
questions.why: Lesson 3 lists a digital detox, cutting non-essential technology and deleting apps that waste time, as the opening step.

questions.q: How does the summary describe the final stage of the ten-day program?
a: Reviewing the eight days and planning to keep the changes
Restarting the entire program from the beginning
Returning to normal routines once the detox ends
Choosing one habit to abandon permanently
questions.why: Lesson 3 says the ninth step evaluates how the previous eight days went, then you make a plan so the changes stick.
